title: Does lynx support shadcn ui?
body: I'm trying to add shadcn to Reactlynx but unable to do it.
author: devHamzza

comments.body:
hi @devHamzza ,

Unlike HTML, Lynx uses some unique element tags such as `<view>`, `<text>` and `<image>` to display different content. Therefore, shadcn cannot be used directly in ReactLynx, but we will support tailwindcss in the future, making it easy to port.
We will close this issue for now. Please feel free to reopen it if you have any further questions.
